name: gizza-ai/image-pixelate-censor
summary: Pixelate or blur a region of an image to censor it.

tool.description: Censor a rectangular region of an image (e.g. a face, license plate, or sensitive text) by pixelating it into a mosaic (default) or blurring it. Give the region as x, y, width, height in pixels (0-based from the top-left; clamped to the image). mode is 'pixelate' or 'blur'; strength sets the mosaic tile size (pixelate) or blur radius (blur). Only the region is changed; the rest is untouched. Returns a PNG. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

x.description: Left edge of the region to censor (pixels from the left).

y.description: Top edge of the region to censor (pixels from the top).

width.description: Width of the region in pixels (clamped to the image).

height.description: Height of the region in pixels (clamped to the image).

mode.description: Censor style: pixelate (mosaic, default) or blur.

strength.description: Pixelate: mosaic tile size in px (default 16). Blur: blur radius/sigma (default 12). 0 = default.
